author: GamingBolt
description:
We had been waiting for a closer look at Fable for a long time, and we’re glad that it’s finally arrived. That’s because it's shaping up to be an adventure that brings all of the franchise’s humor and eccentricities to a take on Albion that’s looking quite intriguing. 

And that isn’t just because of a world in which you’re making the most of a combat system that allows for some creative approaches, or an exploration loop that could have you eager to cover as much distance as you can. 

Instead, we’re fascinated by how every place you go is designed to get you invested in the local population and economy, giving you so many ways to craft small, meaningful moments that add depth to your story, and influence the kind of Hero you aim to be. 

Join us as we explore how Fable’s secret sauce is more about the people you meet instead of the places you’re going to go.
title: Fable Might Finally Be Bringing Back The One RPG Feature EVERYONE FORGOT

author: GamingBolt
description:
When you think about how Naughty Dog has been a very strong presence in Sony’s first-party line-up for previous generations of the PlayStation, it’s easy to see how the PS5 hasn’t really had anything "new: that reflects the studio’s penchant for innovation in the last six years. Yes, we’ve got high hopes for Intergalactic, but there’s that nagging feeling that something has been off at the studio for a while.

Why is that? We sat down and thought about it all, and what we’ve got to say might resonate with you if you’ve been wanting more from a studio that has often brought out multiple releases on past iterations of the PlayStation. Join us as we take a look at the silence, and the potential to turn things around, for Naughty Dog as the PS5 nears the end of its life-cycle.

This is a follow up to our original video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GCu1kou2sSQ
title: We NEED To Talk About Naughty Dog...
